6.name: Our Investigation of the Vogel Victorian
6.overview: The charmingly spooky walls of the Vogel Victorian have a new set of guests and they're interested in talking to the paranormal ones!

6.name: The Ghouls Boys Get After Some Ghosts at the Waffle House
6.overview: Wait! No, not that Waffle House! The only thing cooking at the Willella Howe-Waffle House are the ghosts!

6.name: Ghost Hunting With Our Wives (ft. Mari & Sara)
6.overview: It's date night at the Winchester Mystery House! Ryan and Shane bring their better halves up to San Jose to show them what it means to be a Professional Ghost Hunter. Will the power of true love be enough to draw out some ghouls, or will the boys buckle under the newfound pressure?

6.name: The Grey Lady of Willard Library
6.overview: Ryan and Shane live out every dark academia student's dream: Ghost hunting in a library! What forbidden knowledge will they unearth in the stacks of Willard Library?

6.name: The Eerie Corridors of Preston Castle
6.overview: The boys trek up north to visit California's Preston Castle!

6.name: The Disturbing Depths of the USS Hornet
6.overview: The boys descend into the eerily preserved corridors of the USS Hornet and explore its historic decks.

6.name: The Lively Spirits of the Alex Vega Firehouse
6.overview: The summer's about to heat up as the boys kick off their Key West investigations in the Alex Vega Firehouse that's pipin' hot with activity!

6.name: The Harrowing Ascent Up Key West's Haunted Lighthouse
6.overview: Ryan and Shane become the first ghost hunters ever to investigate the Key West Lighthouse.

6.name: The Ghoul Boys vs Robert the Doll
6.overview: Shane is never beating the demon allegations.

6.name: Sleeping At Oregon's Most Haunted Lighthouse
6.overview: The GHOST UP THE COAST roadtrip begins with what may be our most picturesque location yet!

6.name: The Terrifying Delights of the Enchanted Forest
6.overview: The Ghosts Up the Coast trip continues as the boys gain access to the Enchanted Forest. Are these whimsical attractions drawing something other than tourists?
